text: かみが　はってある……　わからないことが　あったら　ヘルプ！

structure.jp: かみが　はってある……
structure.en: a paper has been posted here...

structure.jp: わからないことが　あったら
structure.en: if there is something you don't understand

patterns.name: 〜てある
patterns.explanation: てある after a verb says someone did the thing earlier and it is still that way now. はってある = 'has been stuck up and is still there'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'when' that thing happens. あったら = 'if there is'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb put right before a thing word describes that thing. わからないこと = 'a thing you don't understand'.
